findings.constraint: multi-core top-k requires vocab to be a power of 2 AND < 65536; else falls back to single-core
findings.fix: No action needed - kernel will use the single-core path. Decode throughput will be lower.

findings.constraint: shared MoE block hardcodes top-2 routing
findings.fix: Lift mixtral_moe.py to parameterize top-k, or use the model-specific MoE in models/demos/{gpt_oss,deepseek_v3}.

findings.constraint: shared MoE block assumes num_experts == 8 (one expert per device on a T3K)
findings.fix: Use a per-model MoE in demos, or refactor the shared block to parameterize expert count.

findings.constraint: sliding-window attention is not supported in combination with chunked prefill
findings.fix: If using long-context prefill, disable chunked prefill for sliding-window layers.

findings.constraint: num_key_value_heads must be divisible by TP(8); GQA/MQA shards KV across the mesh's TP dim
findings.fix: Use TP that divides 4 (e.g. 1, 2, 4), or replicate KV (not supported in tt_transformers).

findings.constraint: num_attention_heads must be divisible by TP(32) so each shard owns whole heads
findings.fix: Use TP that divides 48, or accept replicated attention.

findings.constraint: num_key_value_heads must be divisible by TP(32); GQA/MQA shards KV across the mesh's TP dim
findings.fix: Use TP that divides 4 (e.g. 1, 2, 4), or replicate KV (not supported in tt_transformers).
